Short North Corner Unit | $334,000
765 Park St #6, Columbus, OH 43215
2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1,070 square feet, built 1996. HOA is $380 monthly and there is also a $60 per month amenity fee. Property tax: $4,900 per year. Homeowners insurance runs $85 a month. Seller will credit up to 2.5% of the sale price. Closing costs for the buyer: about $8,300 total. Reserved garage spot, extra $90/mo.
